bathing in the rain might not be as refreshing as it sounds while rainwater is naturally pure the first rain can be particularly problematic due to contaminants it may carry here are some reasons why bathing in the rain might not be ideal 1 2 pollutants and toxins the first rain can wash away dirt pollutants and residues from the atmosphere and surface runoffs making it potentially acidic and harmful to the skin these pollutants can cause skin irritation allergic reactions and other health issues microorganisms rainwater can contain bacteria viruses and parasites that can cause waterborne diseases like cholera typhoid and diarrhea these microorganisms can also lead to skin infections and other health problems skin issues prolonged exposure to rainwater can strip the skin of its natural oils leading to dryness and irritation some people might experience skin rashes fungal infections or other skin conditions due to the pollutants and bacteria in rainwater respiratory problems breathing in polluted air during the first rain can trigger respiratory issues especially for people with asthma or other pre existing conditions hypothermia taking a cold shower or bath especially during rainy weather can lower body temperature significantly and increase the risk of hypothermia

supreme court s role in impeachment proceedings is limited and it s generally understood that the court should not interfere with the senate s impeachment process except in specific circumstances separation of powers the philippine constitution divides power among the three branches of government the executive legislative and judicial impeachment is a constitutional process that involves the legislative branch congress and the senate and is aimed at holding public officials accountable role of the supreme court the supreme court s primary role is to interpret the constitution and laws in the context of impeachment the court s role might be limited to 1 interpreting the constitution the court can interpret the constitution to ensure that the impeachment process is conducted in accordance with constitutional provisions 2 reviewing procedural matters the court might review procedural issues related to the impeachment process such as the validity of the articles of impeachment or the senate s jurisdiction however the court generally should not interfere with the senate s discretion in conducting the impeachment trial as this is a matter of legislative prerogative why the sc should not interfere the supreme court should exercise restraint in interfering with the impeachment process to 1 respect separation of powers interfering with the impeachment process could be seen as overstepping the court s authority and intruding into the domain of the legislative branch 2 allow the senate to exercise its constitutional role the senate has a constitutional role in trying and deciding impeachment cases and the court should allow it to exercise this role without undue interference by exercising restraint the supreme court can maintain the balance of power among the branches says it is immediately executory university of the philippines constitutional law professor john molo weighs in watch what happens if senate proceeds to try vp sara duterte despite sc order what options does the senate have in asserting to convene as an impeachment court when the decision of the supreme court says it is immediately executory university of the philippines constitutional law professor john molo weighs in the judiciary is a human institution and it has erred so many times before there have been moments were it shirked from its solemn role to uphold and defend the constitution among others in javellana v executive secretary g r no l 36142 march 31 1973 for example the supreme court virtually dodged its obligation to check whether the ratification of the 1973 constitution by the marcos administration was done properly when it hid behind technicalities through the motness and political question doctrines justice tehankees dissent stated that ours is a government of laws not of men and when the highest court of the land looks the other way while the fundamental law is being torn asunder it ceases to be a court of justice in de leon v duterte g r no 253118 may 8 2020 the supreme court dismissed a petition for mandamus for the disclosure of the presidents health records during the height of the pandemic without even requiring a comment from the solicitor general in his dissent justice leonen said that the court missed an opportunity to affirm that in a constitutional democracy even the most powerful are answerable to the people in republic v sereno g r no 237428 may 12 2018 the supreme court shattered the most basic rule that impeachable officials may only be removed by impeachment the dissenters therein said that the majority has obliterated the carefully crafted system of checks and balances embedded in our constitution and we have become enablers of impunity today we weaken the very institution we are sworn to protect given the above lets not even have the illusion that the supreme court is always right in the book of marites danguilan vitug she reminded all of us that the court is not as cloistered or as independent as many believe it breathes the same air as the political branches of government today is indeed a sad day for checks and balances in this country while the decision is not yet out for public consumption it has already created the impression that the supreme court has decided to arrogate upon itself a power that was exclusively supposed to be vested in the house of representatives and it has failed to stay in its own lane worse some comments i see already perceive the institution as a protector of the dutertes as the majority of the justices were appointed by rodrigo duterte there is still an opportunity for the supreme court to correct what i respectfully submit is a huge mistake it has committed hopefully it will reverse itself after the proper filing of a motion for reconsideration otherwise trust in the judiciary as an institution may further be eroded and it will become an institution that may be considered as so damaged that i am uncertain if it will ever be the same again atty dino singson de leon
